title: docs(changeset): six PENDING changesets cite a `tracked as #N` card that is now closed — the citation's implication of pending work ships into a CHANGELOG at the next release
body:
Six **pending** changesets carry a `tracked as #N` forward reference whose card is now `closed` / `completed`. Each ships that stale implication of pending work into a CHANGELOG at the next release.

Found by the objectui#9042 dev while fixing the two changesets that card names. Filed rather than ridden in, per that card's do-not-widen instruction. ⛔ Not graded — `domain:*` and priority are triage's.

## The six, verified on `main` and by card state

| pending changeset | forward reference | card state |
|---|---|---|
| `.changeset/5293-view-sort-order-spelling.md` | `tracked as objectui#6011` | closed / completed 2026-08-25 |
| `.changeset/olive-pears-invent.md` | `tracked as objectui#7170` | closed / completed 2026-09-01 |
| `.changeset/7165-grid-dependent-values.md` | `tracked as #7188` | closed / completed 2026-09-02 |
| `.changeset/7655-chatbot-registration-authoring-faces.md` | `tracked as objectui#7708` | closed / completed 2026-09-06 |
| `.changeset/7727-conditional-formatting-record-scope.md` | `tracked as objectui#8166` | closed / completed 2026-09-10 |
| `.changeset/8934-chatter-feed-affordance-only.md` | `tracked as objectui#8983` | closed / completed 2026-09-10 |

**Control:** the `.changeset/` directory holds 1363 entries and the same flattened read finds these six, so the population is real and the query is live. A control card known open (#9042) reads `open` on the same instrument, so the six `closed` readings are not an artefact of the state reader.

⚠️ **Read the phrase on a FLATTENED file.** A line-based grep for one of these sentences returned a **false 0** during objectui#9042 because the phrase spans a line break — it read exactly like "the clause is already gone". Flatten whitespace, or anchor across lines with a count assertion.

## ⛔ The important part: this is NOT objectui#9042 again, and it is weaker

objectui#9042's site 2 was worth fixing because its **headline claim** had been falsified — *"is inert on this block"*, *"`groupBy` is required on this face"*. What is measured here is only that the **citation's implication** is stale: "tracked as #N" is still literally true (the card did track it), and only the suggestion that the work is still pending has expired. That is the clause objectui#9042 ranked **least** important, and it is the whole of this card.

⚠️ **⛔ The real work is a verification that has NOT been done.** For each of the six, the question is whether the *surrounding* claim was also falsified when its card closed — which is what would raise any of them from cosmetic to a objectui#9042-class defect. The filing dev looked at the sentences and saw no falsified headline, but did **not** verify the surrounding claims, and said so. ⇒ Whoever takes this must do that reading **first**, per changeset, and report per changeset; a mechanical sweep that rewrites six citations without it would be motion, not repair.

## Timing

`.changeset/*.md` is release-note **input**, consumed at publish. These reach a reader at the next release. After that, a correction belongs in a docs-only PR against the affected `CHANGELOG.md` — ⛔ never as a rider on a code PR.

## Two things deliberately not asserted

- ⛔ **No claim that all six should be edited.** If the per-changeset reading finds a citation whose surrounding claim still holds, leaving the citation alone is a legitimate outcome — say so rather than normalising the sweep.
- ⛔ **Not the same as a phrase match.** `the other eight` also occurs in `.changeset/8447-valuedatasource-dollar-operator-refusal.md` and `.changeset/record-detail-builtin-label-i18n-4645.md`; those are **different objects** matched on a common English phrase, with no evidence of a miscount. Recorded so a later sweep does not fold them in.
